question: Where is the goddess positioned and what is she bearing on her right side?
premises: The goddess is described as bearing something on the right.
She is situated above the kāma-bīja.
inference: The goddess is visualized on the right as bearing and situated above the kāma-bīja.
uncertainties: The exact object borne on the right is not explicitly named in this verse.
plain_english: Meditate on the goddess on the right, bearing and situated above the kāma-bīja.
